items.name: Finset.gcd
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) : α

items.name: Finset.Int.finsetGcd_nonneg
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℤ} : 0 ≤ s.gcd f

items.name: Finset.gcd_def
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {s : Finset β} {f : β → α} : s.gcd f = (Multiset.map f s.val).gcd

items.name: Finset.gcd_eq_gcd_image
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {s : Finset β} {f : β → α} [DecidableEq α] : s.gcd f = (Finset.image f s).gcd id

items.name: Finset.gcd_empty
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {f : β → α} : ∅.gcd f = 0

items.name: Finset.gcd_singleton
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {f : β → α} {b : β} : {b}.gcd f = normalize (f b)

items.name: Finset.normalize_gcd
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {s : Finset β} {f : β → α} : normalize (s.gcd f) = s.gcd f

items.name: Finset.gcd_image
items.type: {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_4} [CommMonoidWithZero α] [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {f : β → α} [DecidableEq β] {g : γ → β} (s : Finset γ) : (Finset.image g s).gcd f = s.gcd (f ∘ g)
